text:
TAP::score
Description
This command returns or updates risk score.
- If score specified sets supplied score.
- If not specified, returns an integer value from (0 to 100).
-  If supplied score to set function returns previous score.
Syntax
TAP
::
score
[
score
]
Examples
when
TAP_REQUEST
{
if
{
([
TAP
::
score
]
>
85
)
}
{
drop
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
TAP_REQUEST
Introduced: BIGIP-15.0
